# Test Fixtures

Synthetic sample documents shared by all test suites (ADR-003). No confidential or customer content. Tests copy a fixture to a temporary directory before translating it and assert the fixture's hash is unchanged.

| File | Origin | Covers |
|------|--------|--------|
| `pptx/deck.pptx` | Authored by native PowerPoint 16 (build 20326) with `docs/experiments/ooxml-roundtrip/make_fixtures.ps1 -Part pptx` | Title/subtitle placeholders, speaker notes, bold red run, italic run, run hyperlink, table, grouped shapes, text box, slide-number field, SmartArt, chart, runs split by language |
| `docx/report.docx` | Generated by `uv run docs/experiments/ooxml-roundtrip/build_docx.py` (Word automation hangs on this host when saving fields, comments or tracked changes) | Heading, bold run, footnote with separators, `w:hyperlink`, DATE `fldSimple`, complex HYPERLINK field, table with nested table, header, footer, comment, tracked insertion and deletion, DrawingML text box with VML fallback |
| `xlsx/features-shared.xlsx`, `xlsx/features-inline.xlsx` | Generated by `uv run docs/experiments/xlsx-roundtrip/spike.py` (shared-string and inline-string storage of the same workbook) | Chinese labels, rich text, formulas with caches, cross-sheet formula, named range, hyperlinks, numbers, dates, boolean, a literal string starting with `=`, comment, validation, conditional formatting, merged cells, row/column sizes, frozen panes, chart, image, drawing text box |
| `xlsx/labels.xlsx` | Authored by native Excel 16 with `docs/experiments/xlsx-recalc/make_fixture.ps1` | Formulas whose string literals are translated labels (COUNTIF, SUMIF, IF, VLOOKUP, concatenation), cross-sheet reference, CJK sheet names |

Constructs that are awkward to author (fields spanning paragraphs, content controls, bookmarks, master/layout text, nested groups, malformed packages) are derived from these files inside the tests by editing their XML, so each test states exactly what it adds. TXT fixtures are written by the tests themselves, and PDF fixtures by `tests/support/pdf.py` with PyMuPDF's built-in fonts (heading, wrapped paragraph, colored span, bullets, table cells in filled boxes, centered label, underlined link, image, rule, page number; scanned, rotated, encrypted and signed variants).
